BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to adulterated pet food; adding a new section tochapter 15.53 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds and declares that petsare important to the citizens of Washington and that consumers of thisstate have a right to be protected from unfair or deceptive acts orpractices in the manufacture of pet food. The intent of this act is tomake the knowing manufacture of adulterated pet food a violation of thestate's consumer protection act, which will subject violators to trebledamages.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 15.53 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Knowingly manufacturing adulterated pet food is not reasonable inrelation to the development and preservation of business and is anunfair or deceptive act in trade or commerce and an unfair method ofcompetition for the purpose of applying the consumer protection act, p. 1 SB 6258chapter 19.86 RCW.
